LUMEN Protocol

LUMEN is a cognitive operating system for agents. It gives a language model permanent memory, reasoning chains that survive context compression, and a process database with MUMPS heritage.

The protocol is transport-agnostic: the same tools speak JSON-RPC over stdio, a binary framing over shared memory, and a REST surface over HTTP.

Why it exists

Context windows are finite and models forget. LUMEN moves the state out of the window so the agent can keep working across sessions without re-reading the world.
